reviews.text: My cat stopped eating, and although I took her to another vet, she didn't get any better. This vet was able to find the cause with an ultrasound. Their explanation was easy to understand, and I'm so grateful.

My dog ​​suffered from diarrhea many times (more than 10 times).
I was usually told to fast and given anti-diarrheal medication and probiotics. I was also told to change his food, and I tried many different kinds, but nothing improved. I was very worried.

I heard about food allergy testing from another doctor (a phone consultation through my insurance company), and when I requested it here, I was told, "There's no such magical test. If there was, I'd want to do it myself! (laughs)"
I wondered if the doctor I spoke to was incompetent, so I consulted a friend who owns a dog, and she said she had had food allergy testing done.

I'm truly saddened. I had trusted this doctor and had been going there for over a year, so this is very painful.

Also, during his neutering surgery, he had some teeth extracted, but one of his front baby teeth remains.

The instructor is kind and highly skilled.

The salon is also very clean.

Highly recommended for those living in Hiroo or Ebisu!

Maybe it was summer fatigue or the change in environment...
My pet seemed a little lethargic and I was worried about its runny nose and cough, so I looked up local clinics on a map and found this place.
It's a very clean clinic, and both the receptionist and the doctor were very kind, which I really liked.
The examination was of course thorough, and they really helped to alleviate each of my concerns.
They didn't rush into any tests, but instead prescribed antibiotics and other treatments, saying they'd wait and see how things went, and the examination was over.
The way the doctor interacted with the animals, especially the way he touched them, was very reassuring, and I feel like this is the clinic I'd like to use as my regular doctor if anything concerning comes up in the future.
Thank you very much for your time.
